newsitem.title: GREECE: Balkaninvest buys stake in Yugo soft drinks firm.
newsitem.headline: Balkaninvest buys stake in Yugo soft drinks firm.

text.p: Balkaninvest Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of 3E Hellenic Bottling, acquired a 68 percent stake in IBP Beograd, the leading soft drink producer in the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, the company said.

"The investor paid the dollar equivalent of over 84 million dinars for the acquisition of the above stake. It has been agreed that an additional amount of $24 million will be invested in IBP within 1997," Hellenic Bottling said.
The investment will increase capacity, modernise operations and improve the distribution network to satisfy the anticipated demand for Coca-Cola products, it said.
"The investment underlines the confidence of IBP, the Leventis organisation and the Coca-Cola Company to the potential and future development of the Yugoslav economy," the company said.

Balkaninvest is part of the Leventis organisation, one of the leading bottlers of the Coca-Cola system worldwide. It owns over 45 bottling facilities in Greece, Nigeria, the Republic of Ireland, Bulgaria, Armenia, Moldova, Romania and Russia where the soft drinks are produced and distributed.
Shares of Hellenic Bottling closed up 250 drachmas at 9,100 on Wednesday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
